title: UMCD typed split child artifact roster v3
description: The exact roster bytes are detached-signature verified. artifact_root names one directory below the roster directory. The listed paths must exactly cover every regular file beneath that directory; symlinks, hard links, special files, and unlisted files are rejected. Each frozen child must have a ChannelDataset NPZ whose rows bind to that child, kind, and parent. Recognized NR trajectory stores are traversed through content and record hashes and checked against split lineage. NR record-store manifests and their content-addressed NPZ payloads are paired, hash-checked, and checked against the same split binding. Every v3 artifact type must have a semantic validator; types without one are rejected. Exact subtree inventory does not establish authoritative corpus completeness or release qualification.
